rows.definition: The identifier spelling tDEBT that the scorecard's identifier scanner reads out of the tab-escape-prefixed DEBT column labels in fak's tab-separated status table headers - the loop status table (cmd/fak/loop.go), the superloop member table (cmd/fak/superloop.go), and the debtlane wave slot table (internal/debtlane/wave.go); the leading t is the tail of the \t tab escape fused onto the DEBT column label by the identifier regex, so the token names the DEBT header column, not a debt measurement.
rows.distinction: A table-header rendering artifact, NOT a debt metric: unlike total_debt or debt_by_kpi (real scored debt integers folded into the corpus), tDEBT measures nothing - it is only the column under which per-lane/per-member debt counts are printed.

rows.definition: abi.ReasonIntegrityRefuted is the core ABI refusal reason code (wire name INTEGRITY_REFUTED) attached to a deny verdict when the witness resolver actively refutes the claimed effect - the proof presented contradicts the claim, so the call is refused even though a witness was supplied.
rows.distinction: A refusal REASON on the deny verdict, NOT the WitnessRefuted outcome value in the world-state witness triple, NOT callavoid's economic ProofRefuted break-even status, and NOT ReasonUnwitnessed, which fires when no corroborating witness exists at all - here a witness was found and it contradicts the claim.
